class.name: NNActionGroup
class.brief_description: Creates sequences of actions, or picks one random action from several choices.
class.description: This node type should be added as child nodes of the [NNBehaviour] node. They are used when a behaviour is being executed by the AI agent. Action groups can be used to create sequences of actions, pick one random action from several choices, branch with an if/else condition, or select actions with a custom script rule. This allows for more complex actions to be performed by a behaviour. You can nest as many action groups as you need, and they can contain any number and combination of actions or action groups. With [code]PickOneAtRandom[/code], only enabled child actions and action groups are candidates when the group starts; if none are enabled, or if the chosen child is later disabled, the group does not reroll and ends without running another child. With [code]IfElse[/code], if the chosen branch (child 0 or child 1) is missing or disabled, the group does not fall back to the other branch and ends without running an action.

members.member: A choice of how the actions that are child nodes are executed: Sequence:0,PickOneAtRandom:1,IfElse:2,CustomRule:3. [code]Sequence[/code] executes enabled child actions from top to bottom, skipping disabled ones. [code]PickOneAtRandom[/code] picks one enabled child uniformly at random when the group starts. [code]IfElse[/code] uses [member if_else_boolean_value] to choose child 0 ([code]true[/code]) or child 1 ([code]false[/code]). [code]CustomRule[/code] calls a user-defined [code]eval()[/code] method on this node when the group starts (with [member current_action_index] reset to [code]-1[/code]) and again whenever the group needs the next child (after a child finishes, becomes disabled, fails under [code]ContinueExecution[/code], or if [code]eval()[/code] left [member current_action_index] at [code]-1[/code] on start). Set [member current_action_index] to the index of an enabled child to run it, or to [code]-1[/code] to end the group.

The child index of the currently active [NNAction] or nested [NNActionGroup]. Defaults to [code]0[/code] before the group has run, and is set to [code]-1[/code] when the group ends. Under the [code]CustomRule[/code] execution rule, a script's [code]eval()[/code] method sets this property to select a child index to run, or [code]-1[/code] to stop the group.

How a child that finishes with [member NNActions.has_failed] set is handled: EndExecution:0,ContinueExecution:1. EndExecution stops the group and marks it as failed, so its parent treats the whole group as failed. ContinueExecution reports the failure through [signal action_failed] and carries on with the execution rule; the group itself does not fail.
The condition used by the [code]IfElse[/code] execution rule: [code]true[/code] runs the first child action, [code]false[/code] runs the second.

signal.name: action_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a child [param action_node] of this group finishes with [member NNActions.has_failed] set. With the EndExecution [member error_handling_rule] the group is marked as failed before the signal is emitted.
